value.rationale: The width-unbounded three-row grid is a canonical corner-glued square sequence. At k=4 it is the immediate first case not covered by published k=2,3 rectangular-grid homotopy theorems, and the prior author explicitly highlights k>3 corner gluing as a bottleneck. An exact all-width topological Euler formula with a structural 54-state annihilation certificate is a natural and independently useful invariant, and forces the number of conjectural five-spheres if such a wedge exists. It does not claim that still-open homotopy conclusion.
